Letter of Representation
12/08/2023
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1378
Our client: Carla Franco
Date of loss: 10/05/2023
Dear Claims Representative:
This firm represents the individual injured in the parking lot collision referenced in your file. Please direct all further
communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, in
writing, or in person. Should you receive any statement, request, or inquiry from our client, please refer it to us
promptly.
We ask that you provide a complete copy of the policy declarations page and disclose the bodily injury and property
damage liability limits applicable to the insured dirver and vehicle involved in this incident, together with any other
coverage that may apply.
We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes photographs, dash
camera or surveillance footage, vehicle telematics, recorded statements, adjuster notes, claim file materials, repair
estimates, and any physical components of the vehicles involved. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal
procedures that could affect these materials.
Kindly acknowledge receipt of this letter and confirm in writing that the requested preservation steps have been taken.
We look forward to your prompt response.
Sincerely,
Sarah Combs
Brown & Shaw Law Group
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
